name: @naviary-sanctuary/kinship
description: A deterministic, renderer-neutral pedigree topology engine for Naviary.
author: Naviary Sanctuary

scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run test:node
scripts.fmt: oxfmt src tests .github/package-smoke/consumer.mts README.md CONTRIBUTING.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md INTEROPERABILITY.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json
scripts.build: node --eval "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
